name: Yakouga
summary:
It is an orthodox shooter that uses shots and bombs to progress.
Collecting crystals released by enemies will power up your shots. There is no upper limit to the level of your shots, so the more you repeat, the stronger they will become.
You can accumulate bombs by hitting enemy bullets.
When you kill an enemy, it will explode with surrounding enemy bullets, and adjacent enemy bullets will detonate more and more.
